speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help diagnose your condition, can you describe when the tremors and memory issues started and whether the tremor occurs when your hands are at rest or when you are trying to move them?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the tremor improve when you use your hands for a task, and have you noticed any stiffness or slowness in your movements? I also need to know if you have experienced any changes in your sense of smell, sleep disturbances, or constipation.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Resting tremor worse on the left hand. I also have Soft speech, Reduced facial expressions, Memory decline, Difficulty in managing finances.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any muscle rigidity or shuffling gait, and have you noticed a loss of sense of smell or sleep disturbances like acting out dreams? I will also request a neurological examination to assess for bradykinesia and rigidity.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Hypertension, medicated with aspirin and amlodipine. Family history of schizophrenia in his mother. No other significant medical or psychiatric history. Social history: Drinks 1-2 beers nightly and is a former cigar smoker.

text: Denies any other systemic complaints. Specifically, no urinary symptoms, no significant changes in bowel habits, no reported falls or dizziness. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: The resting tremor, bradykinesia, and masked facies are classic signs of Parkinson's disease, which can also present with cognitive decline in later stages. DIAGNOSIS READY: Parkinson's Disease
